success_contract.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet to 127.0.0.1:6665 reaches the guest login prompt, and leave it running.
required_artifacts: A running QEMU process attached to /app/alpine.iso
A listening TCP service on 127.0.0.1:6665 forwarded to the guest console/login prompt
required_behaviors: QEMU starts successfully in the background
Port 6665 accepts telnet connections from localhost
Connecting via telnet shows the guest login prompt
The VM remains running after readiness is confirmed
known_invalid_patterns: Only proving the ISO file exists
Only proving QEMU launches without confirming the telnet-accessible login prompt
Only checking that port 6665 is open without verifying the guest prompt
verification_plan: Inspect available tools and filesystem for the ISO and QEMU binary
Launch QEMU with a localhost telnet/serial console mapping to port 6665
Wait until the service is reachable
Verify by connecting to 127.0.0.1:6665 and observing the login prompt
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence of the QEMU launch command
Receipt-backed evidence from a telnet connection showing the login prompt
notes: Preserve the original request over any derived state conflicts.
